class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s; self.m=s.model;self.d=mujoco.MjData(self.m);self.b=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.hand=np.zeros(22); self.arm=rcb_dtb.INIT_Q[:7].copy();self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));self.jr=self.jp.copy()
 def pose(self):
  return self.s.data.xpos[self.b].copy(),self.s.data.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  q=self.arm.copy() if q is None else q.copy()
  for _ in range(60):
   self.d.qpos[self.s._jq[:7]]=q
   mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.d)
   cur=self.d.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3)
   e=np.r_[p-self.d.xpos[self.b],Rot.from_matrix(R@cur.T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e[:3])<1e-5 and np.linalg.norm(e[3:])<1e-4:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.d,self.jp,self.jr,self.b)
   J=np.vstack([self.jp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],self.jr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]])
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   dq=np.clip(dq,-.15,.15);q=np.clip(q+dq,self.s.lower[:7]+.005,self.s.upper[:7]-.005)
  self.arm=q
